headline: Buying Identities, Syndicate Causes Billions in Losses on the Stock Exchange
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) detained three suspects accused of manipulating warrant trading. The alleged scheme caused losses of Rp6.97 billion.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, and it enforces rules against market manipulation to protect investors.
original_headline: Modal Beli Identitas, Komplotan Ini Bikin Rugi Miliaran di Bursa
